content.title: Sinners' Autumn Durald Arkapaw Invites 'All the Women' at 2026 Oscars to Stand Up as She Makes History in Her Category
content.text: 0 seconds of 3 minutes, 25 secondsVolume 0% NEED TO KNOW Autumn Durald Arkapaw had a special request for the crowd at the 2026 Oscars while accepting the award for Best CinematographyThe director of photography for Sinners became the first woman to ever win in the category "I really want all the women in the room to stand up," Arkapaw said Autumn Durald Arkapaw is sharing her historic Oscars moment. The director of photography for Sinners scored the trophy for Best Cinematography on Sunday, March 15, becoming the first woman in the history of the Academy Awards to do so. As she collected her award, she invited all the women in the crowd at the Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles to "stand up" and join her for the milestone. "I'm so honored to be here and I really want all the women in the room to stand up," Arkapaw said during her speech. "Because I feel like I don't get here without you guys." "I really, really truly mean that," she added. "I have felt so much love from all the women on this whole campaign and have gotten to meet so many people and I just feel like moments like this happen because of you guys and I want to thank you for that." Autumn Durald Arkapaw accepts the award for Best Cinematography at the 2026 Oscars. Kevin Winter/Getty Arkapaw became the first woman to win the Best Cinematography award in the category's nearly 100 years of existence. Before her, only three other women have been recognized in the category. Rachel Morrison was nominated in 2018 for Mudbound, Ari Wegner in 2021 for The Power of the Dog and Mandy Walker in 2022 for Elvis. Arkapaw and Sinners were up against Frankenstein, Marty Supreme, One Battle After Another and Train Dreams in the category. Elsewhere during her speech, Arkapaw thanked Rachel Morrison, as well as Sinners director Ryan Coogler, who she thanked for "believing in me" and "trusting me." "That’s the kind of guy I get to make films with," she added. Related Stories Sinners had a big night at the 2026 Oscars. It was nominated for a record-breaking 16 Academy Awards and snagged wins for Best Original Screenplay, Best Original Score and Best Actor (Michael B. Jordan), in addition to Best Cinematography. Accepting the screenplay award, Coogler, 39, thanked his wife Zinzi Coogler and the couple's three children. "Sev Ohanian and Zinzi Coogler, you guys are the best producers in the world, and Zinzi, you are the best wife and mom in the world," Coogler said during his speech. Autumn Durald Arkapaw accepts the award for Best Cinematography at the 2026 Oscars. Patrick T. Fallon / AFP via Getty; Patrick T. Fallon / AFP via Getty "Every day I get to spend with you is better than the one that came before it," he added of his wife. "And to my parents who are here, thank you for all the memories, thank you for making me believe in myself." "To my babies that are at home watching, I apologize for all the time away. Dad loves you," he shared. "Memories are all we have, and I'll give you some great ones and y'all are blessed to live a long life and [when] Dad becomes just a memory I want you to remember this one thing: I love y'all more than anything.
